entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil.>> We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.

entries.title: Psalms 44:2
segments: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.

entries.title: Psalms 44:3
segments: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 44:5
segments: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:6
segments: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.

entries.title: Psalms 44:7
segments: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:8
segments: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 44:9
segments: But now thou hast cast [us] off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.

entries.title: Psalms 44:10
segments: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: Thou hast made us like sheep [appointed] for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 44:12
segments: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased [thy wealth] by their price.

entries.title: Psalms 44:13
segments: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:14
segments: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 44:15
segments: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: All this is come upon us; Yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.

entries.title: Psalms 44:20
segments: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

entries.title: Psalms 44:21
segments: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

entries.title: Psalms 44:23
segments: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast [us] not off for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 44:24
segments: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 44:26
segments: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness' sake.
